verdict.rationale: RudderStack's official MCP server lets users debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write and test transformations, and review audit logs entirely through natural language. It works from any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Codex). Rudder AI separately offers an AI agent in Slack for managing the workspace, so natural-language operation of the product is clearly first-party. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the natural-language workflows, and documentation depth on how much of the workspace (e.g., creating connections or destinations) can actually be configured via natural-language commands versus only investigated or reviewed.
